title: Dashboarding + alerting for FP8/INT8 benchmark runs and perf canary (model/GPU/region slices)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Build and ship Grafana dashboards + alerts to monitor (a) benchmark matrix execution and (b) staged perf-canary rollout of FP8/INT8 kernels. Must support slicing by model, GPU SKU, region, and kernel mode (baseline/FP8/INT8) and include an explicit handoff to SRE for on-call ownership during rollout.

Context
- This sprint is generating a benchmark matrix + rolling changes behind flags. We need monitoring that answers: “are we actually faster?”, “is TTFT/TPOT regressing in specific cohorts?”, and “are we seeing correctness/errors/timeouts under quantized kernels?”
- Benchmarking noise/variance is a known risk; dashboards should surface sample sizes and variance signals.

Scope
1) Grafana dashboards
A. Benchmark runs dashboard (used by runtime + benchmark lab)
- Primary panels (all sliceable by {model, gpu_sku, region, kernel_mode, build_sha}):
  - TTFT p50/p95 (ms)
  - TPOT p50/p95 (ms/token)
  - End-to-end tokens/sec (aggregate + per-replica where available)
  - Request error rate (5xx + model errors) and timeout rate
  - GPU utilization %, SM occupancy proxy (if available), GPU memory used, KV cache hit rate (if instrumented)
  - Scheduler signals: queue depth, prefill/decode breakdown, batch size distribution
  - Run metadata table: container tag, CUDA/driver, clock-lock state, MIG/partitioning, git SHA
- “Run health” row: show missing dimensions (e.g., no kernel_mode tag), low sample size, or high variance warnings.

B. Perf canary dashboard (used by SRE during staged enablement)
- Canary vs baseline comparison panels:
  - TTFT p95 delta (%) and absolute
  - TPOT p95 delta (%) and absolute
  - tokens/sec delta (%)
  - error rate delta (pp)
  - Saturation signals: queue depth p95, backpressure counters, GPU util/mem
- Dimensions:
  - {model, region, gpu_sku, kernel_mode, canary_cohort} (cohort = enabled/disabled flag state)
- Must include links to the perf-canary runbook and rollback instructions.

2) Alerts
- Alert set for canary cohorts only (reduce noise):
  - TTFT p95 regression above threshold (per model/region/gpu_sku)
  - TPOT p95 regression above threshold
  - Error rate spike (5xx/model errors)
  - Token throughput drop + sustained saturation (guard against capacity/scheduling issues that hide as “latency regressions”)
- Alert routing:
  - During rollout window: page #eng-sre / on-call; notify #eng-runtime for awareness
  - Outside rollout window: warning-only to #eng-runtime (no paging) unless error rate is critical
- Alert annotations must include:
  - model, region, gpu_sku, kernel_mode, cohort, build SHA
  - link to dashboard with pre-set variables

3) SRE handoff
- Add an SRE-facing README (or Confluence snippet link) documenting:
  - dashboard URLs
  - alert meaning + first triage steps
  - who to page in runtime (kernel vs scheduling) for specific symptom patterns
- 30 min handoff walkthrough with Rafael Mendes (SRE rollout/canary owner) + record notes.

Non-goals
- Building new metrics from scratch that require runtime changes (those are tracked separately). We will consume the new tags emitted by runtime once ENG-7425 lands and PR redwood/pr-19934 is deployed.

Dependencies / related work
- ENG-7425 Scheduler instrumentation for prefill/decode mix (required for meaningful scheduler panels)
- ENG-7426 Perf canary thresholds for FP8/INT8 rollout (required for alert profiles)
- Related PRs:
  - observability-pack/pr-377 add FP8/INT8 benchmark and rollout dashboards
  - redwood/pr-19934 metrics tagging: model/gpu/kernel-mode dimensions
- Metric definitions reference: google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/observability/fp8-int8-perf-metrics-definitions.json

Acceptance criteria (Definition of Done)
- [x] Grafana dashboard “FP8/INT8 Benchmark Runs” created with required panels and variables
- [x] Grafana dashboard “FP8/INT8 Canary Rollout” created with baseline vs canary comparisons
- [x] Alert rules created and validated on a small canary cohort (low traffic) with noise suppression
- [x] Dashboard links + alert runbook shared in #eng-sre and #eng-runtime
- [x] SRE handoff completed; ownership noted (SRE owns paging + rollback, runtime owns investigation)

Implementation notes
- Variables: model (string), region (string), gpu_sku (string), kernel_mode (enum baseline|fp8|int8), cohort (enum canary|control), build_sha (string)
- “Sample size” display: include request count/time window in each alert expression to avoid false positives on small sample (see SUP-31881 follow-up).
